data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's categorical claim that resumption must always be refused is inconsistent with its own acknowledged countercondition: if the system emits a 'budget exhausted' marker as part of the logical event stream, the environmental interrupt becomes a logical event, so continuation from that marker with a matching causal fingerprint can preserve append-only identity. The target asserts always-refuse rather than adjudicating this rival criterion, so it does not determine exactly when resumption may occur.
